0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 2-3 at home, 0-5 on the road) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-4, 5-0 at home, 3-4 on the road) in their 11th game of the season. The Clippers, fourth in the Pacific and 13th in the West, have lost their last game and are 7.5 games back in their division, while the Thunder, third in the Northwest and seventh in the West, are 0.5 games back and have lost their last two. The Clippers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 108-101 in Oklahoma City, and they lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season. For the Clippers, Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out, and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. For the Thunder, Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee) are out.
